value.rationale: The integer morphism and its torsion cokernel are motivated natural invariants of graph-coloring reconfiguration under cyclic graph covers. The nontrivial parity cancellation makes a degree-two target covering induce primitive homology transfer for odd base cycles, contrasted with an index-two map for even base cycles; the all-sector Smith theorem quantifies this distinction.
